top_signals.title: Elon Musk talks up AI safety while fighting regulation in wild week of strange alliances
top_signals.summary: In the past week, Musk has agreed with the CEOs of Anthropic and OpenAI, while getting contradicted by President Trump and Nvidia's Jensen Huang.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
